feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Julia Jacklin on her latest album, 'The Gem'
entry.summary: The Australian musician's newest album is named for a neighborhood bar in Melbourne that just so happens to have a recording studio upstairs.

entry.title: 'To Catch a Predator' drama 'Primetime' brings the sleaze, and it's almost enough
entry.summary: Primetime dramatizes the story behind the series To Catch a Predator. It's full of big swings from the director and the actors — but doesn't engage with the most complicated questions the series raised.

entry.title: Netanyahu rages against critics, including Mamdani, at the U.N. General Assembly
entry.summary: Middle East crises draw major focus as the U.N. General Assembly hears from Israel, the Palestinian Authority and Yemen.

entry.title: Mom! Mom! MOM! 3 ways to stay calm in stressful parenting moments
entry.summary: Parenthood can be overwhelming. A therapist and mom of three shares techniques to help calibrate your emotions — so you can show up better for yourself and your family.

entry.title: Fill in the blank in the quiz: Trump's says his triumphal arch will include _____
entry.summary: Plus: It's a very special week! But which one?

entry.title: Is Switzerland's neutrality at a crossroads?
entry.summary: Switzerland is voting on whether to tighten its famous neutrality — a move that could reshape its response to Russia and future conflicts.

entry.title: Years after storms, clean-up crews meticulously separate the sentimental from the wreckage
entry.summary: Across the country, lost-and-found networks seek to reunite objects with disaster survivors. The work can take years. In some cases, it's impossible to pick up all the pieces.

entry.title: The U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve is low. Here's why you should care
entry.summary: The U.S. has tapped into its strategic oil reserve to help drive down rising gasoline prices in the wake of the war with Iran. Can oil from Venezuela help fill it back up?

entry.title: American farmers are hurting -- and worried about their futures
entry.summary: Farmers who grow soybeans, corn, cotton and other crops are facing another year of losses as soaring fuel and fertilizer costs offset higher revenues.

entry.title: As election enters its final stretch, some Republicans are distancing from Trump
entry.summary: With less than six weeks until Election Day, a growing number of Republicans are breaking from Trump on key issues. It comes as the party is scrambling to hold onto a slim majority in Congress.
